item.title: Creditors accept ex-Montreal mayor Denis Coderre's debt-repayment plan
item.description: MONTREAL — Creditors of former Montreal mayor Denis Coderre have unanimously accepted a proposal for him to pay back less than a quarter of his roughly $1.1-million debt.

item.title: Ottawa gives conditional approval for Marineland to export remaining belugas to U.S.
item.description: Marineland's belugas have received a reprieve from death row after the federal government conditionally approved a plan to export the last remaining captive whales in Canada to the United States.

item.title: Top court orders new law licence assessment for man who sexually abused children
item.description: TORONTO — Ontario's top court has ordered a new assessment for a man who sexually abused children to determine whether he has the "good character" needed to become a lawyer.

item.title: Union, farm groups say cuts at federal agriculture centres will set sector back
item.description: The union representing workers at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada and some farming groups are firing back at Ottawa over abrupt job cuts and closures.
